entries.name: Bytes

entries.name: Pointer
entries.notes: Managed typed handles share targets; reads snapshot ordinary contents. Checked mutation rejects ownership cycles, including container and callable-environment edges. No pointer arithmetic or raw-address API.

entries.name: Null
entries.notes: Explicit Null initializes an absence value and prints null. It is distinct from an unassigned slot and from internal None/Unknown states.

entries.name: List

entries.name: Invalid zero sentinel
entries.notes: The unnamed zero value is a compiler sentinel; it is not one of the 23 named representation tags or a public source constructor. valueTypeCount is an enum bound, not a stored value. Static inspection only.

entries.name: Map
entries.notes: Owned typed values keyed by Text bytes; insertion/replacement and checked reads preserve complete element types and deterministic byte ordering. Distinct from a vocabulary Dictionary.

entries.name: Map
entries.notes: Internal representation tag; executable source semantics are defined by the linked runtime type contract.

entries.name: Instance
entries.notes: A canonical descriptor fixes the runtime field schema and identity. Ordinary fields snapshot; Pointer targets remain shared. Unknown, absent and incorrectly typed fields reject.

entries.name: Instance
entries.notes: Internal representation tag; executable source semantics are defined by the linked runtime type contract.

entries.name: Error
entries.notes: Error values can be constructed, stored, captured and placed in typed containers. App Error is optional until inspected; extracting an absent Error rejects. Direct Show remains unsupported.

entries.name: runtime-captures
entries.notes: Each declaration activation retains a typed environment. Ordinary values snapshot; aliases share callable state and explicit Pointer targets. Reads release borrows before calls/Await; writes reject ownership cycles. App-process capture transport is not inferred.

entries.name: Call
entries.notes: Call invokes an ordinary Function with fresh parameter/local storage and its selected capture environment; it does not run an App process.

entries.name: Return
entries.notes: Return is valid inside an ordinary Function and must match its declared output count and types. Every continuing result-bearing path must return.
